summary: Enhance your financial skills with our Financial Consolidation and Investment Accounting course. Learn essential techniques for effective financial management.
lede: Consolidation training helps finance professionals prepare group financial statements and account for investments in subsidiaries and associates. It builds practical skills in validating trial balances, eliminating intercompany balances, preparing equity-method and goodwill and non-controlling interest schedules, translating foreign operations, and supporting disclosures with structured workpapers and review controls.
audienceIntro: This course is built for finance professionals who prepare or review group reporting, investment accounting schedules, and consolidated financial statements.
prerequisites: Foundation-to-intermediate knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping, financial statement structure, and trial balance preparation is required. You should be comfortable reading balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements, and you should have a working knowledge of basic journal entries; no programming or coding is required. Experience with Excel or a similar spreadsheet tool will help, especially for consolidation workpapers and elimination schedules. Prior exposure to IFRS or GAAP is helpful but not mandatory, because the course starts with core consolidation logic before moving into more complex investment-accounting treatments.
